name: Small Fieldstone Cluster
description: Six sub-rounded granite/gneiss cobbles typical of Ukrainian steppe verges — two large, two medium, two small stones in plain granite and moss-granite palettes, floor-anchored for terrain scatter.

parts.name: Large stone A — granite, back-right
parts.note: 270×210×250 mm — upper Wentworth cobble / small-boulder; center y=h/2 so bottom flush with floor y=0 (design value within sourced range, see needs[])

parts.name: Large stone B — moss granite, back-left
parts.note: 240×180×210 mm; angled left to widen cluster (design value within sourced cobble range)

parts.name: Medium stone C — granite, front-centre
parts.note: 160×120×140 mm; in front of and between the two large stones

parts.name: Medium stone D — moss granite, right
parts.note: 140×100×130 mm; right flank of the cluster

parts.name: Small stone F — moss granite, back-centre
parts.note: 90×70×80 mm; nestled at the rear of the cluster

needs: Exact fieldstone dimensions from a Ukrainian geological field survey or museum/catalog measurement (individual stone w/h/d are design values within the sourced Wentworth cobble range)
Height-to-width oblateness ratio for sub-rounded Ukrainian Shield granite cobbles (assumed ~0.77; not independently sourced)
